image_description: A close-up photograph of a single, unripe green fig attached to a woody branch. The fig is round to slightly pear-shaped with smooth, taut green skin featuring subtle lighter speckling. The ostiole (eye) is visible at the bottom center as a small, brownish circular indentation. Green leaves and stems are visible in the background against a bright blue sky, with natural sunlight creating highlights on the fruit's surface.
